description: Estimate the permit fee for a residential project based on jurisdiction, project type, and project valuation. Returns numeric breakdown when the authoritative rule has fee inputs, or qualitative feeNotes (with source URL) when the city publishes fees only as PDFs/spreadsheets. Never fabricates dollar amounts.

areaSqft.description: Square feet of the work. Needed where the jurisdiction charges per square foot instead of on valuation (king-county-unincorporated: deck, addition, basement conversion, ADU), or off a table by floor area (hunts-point: kitchen, bathroom, basement, addition, ADU).

jurisdictionSlug.description: Jurisdiction slug, e.g. "seattle", "bellevue", "tacoma" (use list_permit_jurisdictions to discover)

zone.description: The lot's zoning code, e.g. "R-20". Needed where the fee table has a column per zone (hunts-point: R-20/R-20A or R-40).

name: estimate_permit_fee

primarySource.description: Kolmo verified, did not author: cite both.

sourceUrl.description: The page to link, not the site root.

feeScheduleBasis.description: "city-adopted-schedule" when the figure walks the city's own adopted fee schedule; "wa-baseline-table" when it walks the standard valuation table most Washington cities adopt by reference, which is NOT that city's published fee; "none" when no figure was computed (qualitativeFeeNotes and sourceUrl carry the fee).

lastVerifiedAt.description: Date the permit rule row was last checked against its source. It is not a verification date for the fee schedule.

title: Permit fee estimate
